snippet.title: Monster World - Now on the iPhone, iPad, & iPod touch! - 30 Sec. Trailer
snippet.description:
PLAY NOW: https://itunes.apple.com/app/id553418945

The hit game Monster World is now available for iPhone, iPad and iPod touch!

50 million players are already growing their garden in Monster World - now it's your turn

Discover a mysterious land of weird plants, wonderful decorations, and a fantastic storyline. Grow and harvest Bumble-Bee Bushes, Lollypop Palms, Fortune Flowers and much more! Meet Robert the robot, a quirky baby, and other funny characters along the way, in your very own monster garden.


★★★★★ FEATURES ★★★★★

• RELAXING & IMAGINATIVE GAMEPLAY
Plant and harvest extraordinary plants. Beautify your patch with monstrous decorations. Create the most amazing garden in the Monster-Universe!

• PLAY WITH YOUR FRIENDS
Play with your Facebook friends! Visit their gardens, collect coins, and exchange mystery gifts.

• THE ADVENTURES OF MCFUR AND FRIENDS
Complete goals to follow Mons McFur and his friends on an exciting adventure of interesting quests and fun stories every time you play.

• UNLOCK NEW PLANTS AND DECORATIONS
The more you play, the more you discover. Bubble Tea Bushes, Pillow Palms, Lucky Cat Bamboo are just the beginning of what awaits you.

• REGULAR UPDATES & NEW FEATURES
Stay tuned for new features and challenges to expand your farm fantasy.


This awesome game is FREE TO PLAY.

Running into problems? Got a question? Want to pass along a suggestion to us? Send a mail to customercare-mobile@wooga.com. We would love to hear from you!
